hypotheses.justification: Split on whether (Nat.card (GL2 q) : K) is zero. If nonzero, the existing orthogonality proof works unchanged. If zero, put τ = Representation.linHom ρ ρ and T = ∑ g, τ g. Reindexing the double sum gives T² = Nat.card (GL2 q) • T = 0. Hence LinearMap.isNilpotent_trace_of_isNilpotent implies trace T = 0, since K is a field. By linearity of trace and Representation.char_linHom, trace T is the required character sum. Thus both sides vanish in the previously excluded characteristics.

Representation.character is defined using LinearMap.trace without requiring finite dimensionality, so the statement still elaborates. The proof constructs IsIrreducible ρ without this hypothesis. For finite GL2 q, Representation.IsIrreducible provides finite dimensionality of ρ.asModule, transferred to V by ρ.asModuleEquiv; Representation.char_orthonormal already performs this transfer internally. The remaining proof therefore works without the binder. Nontriviality remains assumed, and irreducibility rules out any additional infinite-dimensional cases.
